hints.shopId: From the YooKassa dashboard, next to the secret key.
hints.capture: On: one-stage payment, the money is debited right away. Off: two-stage, the amount is held until you capture it.
hints.paymentDescription: Shown to the customer during payment and in the YooKassa dashboard, up to 128 characters. Applied when the storefront doesn't pass one at checkout.
hints.useReceipt: Sends receipt data with every payment for registration under 54-FZ.
hints.useAtolOnlineFFD120: Turn on if the receipts are registered by ATOL Online on FFD 1.2. The tax system then becomes required.
hints.taxSystemCode: Applies to the whole receipt. Items under different tax systems must be sent in separate receipts.
hints.taxItemDefault: Applied to every product line of the receipt.
hints.taxShippingDefault: Applied to the shipping line of the receipt.
